top_signals.title: Western Sydney Airport Opens With Uncertain Prospects
top_signals.summary: Western Sydney International Airport has opened after decades of delays and political turnover, with a billion-dollar price tag. Bloomberg's Paul Allen reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
